title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slips to sixty-two thousand seven hundred fifty dollars, down one point five percent, as fear tightens its grip with the index at twenty-nine. Overnight selling in Asia capped any recovery attempts, leaving price action compressed near recent lows.

Network strength stands out against the sentiment. Hashrate sits at nine hundred twenty-six exahashes per second, underscoring miner conviction even as block height pushes past nine hundred sixty-two thousand.
